use: Priors and constraints for candidate generation and ranking. A rule value never proves that an event happened in a recording.

verification_status_values.secondary_consistent: Two or more secondary sources agree; not yet checked against our recordings.
verification_status_values.recording_consistent: Also consistent with readings from DEVELOPMENT recordings (see docs/game_knowledge_base.md).
verification_status_values.repository_contract: Already fixed by a contract in this repository.

overtime_at_score.note: Overtime continues until one team leads by 2 (or a vote ends it).

round_time_limit_sec.note: Combat phase timer starts at 1:40 after barriers drop.

buy_phase_half_start_sec.note: First round of each half and overtime rounds.

spike_detonation_sec.note: Replaces the round timer after a plant.

hud_ability_order.note: Left to right in the bottom-centre ability HUD; X is the ultimate.

api_slot_to_key.note: valorant-api slot naming. Keybinds are user-configurable; this maps semantic slots, not keys.

max_round_duration_sec.note: Upper bound for a single combat phase including a last-second plant.
